title: Power Platform governance: multi-grader comparison for agent evaluations
summary: The roadmap details and documented background controls are supported, with no blocking findings. Microsoft has not documented agent-response display for multi-grader comparison itself; that statement should be narrowed to the roadmap's evidence wording. The existing-evaluation identity statement also needs its preview qualification.

claims.claim: Existing run comparison is reached in Copilot Studio (maker) at agent > Evaluation > Recent test results > test run > Compare with > comparison run.
claims.quote: In your agent's Evaluation page, under Recent test results, open the test run you want to use as the base for the comparison. Select the Compare with dropdown, and then select the time and date of the test run you want to compare with the currently open test results.
claims.fix: Use 'Agents > agent > Evaluation > Recent test results > test run > Compare with > comparison run'. The omitted Agents listing is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/agents-page; add that source. 'comparison run' is a valid placeholder, not an invented label.

claims.claim: An action rating of none fits the briefing's advice to assess grader fit and pilot the comparison.
claims.quote:
action: "none"
Define which graders your team already trusts.
Use comparison on a pilot test set before changing release criteria.
claims.fix: Set action to 'review': the standard assigns review to an optional capability needing a fit decision, while none means awareness only with nothing to configure or decide. No source establishes an automatic change or a deadline requiring prepare or act-now.
